text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now, which tea shall I have to start the
day?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That sound... My favorite cup cracking...
I know I
was dreaming, but I'll not forget
that sound so
easily.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I can only hope that dream does not
reoccur.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan's nightmare leaves her in
low spirits.
